newsitem.title: USA: Camden files shelf for $500 mln debt, stk.
newsitem.headline: Camden files shelf for $500 mln debt, stk.

text.p: Camden Property Trust filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $500 million in debt securities, common and preferred stock and securities warrants.

Camden intends to use the net proceeds for general corporate purposes, which may include the acquisition and development of multi-family properties as suitable opportunities arise, improvement of certain properties and the repayment of certain then outstanding secured or unsecured indebtedness.
Camden Property Trust, based in Houston, is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust.
